groups.label: Statements and main theorems
groups.gloss: The statements of the Riemann Hypothesis and its Dirichlet generalization, and the five final theorems.

groups.label: Build settings and Hermitian adjoint
groups.gloss: Project-wide settings for instance search and simp, plus the adjoint of a matrix for the Hermitian dot product.

groups.label: Landherr's theorem and Hasse principle
groups.gloss: A local-to-global principle for hermitian spaces over number fields: a unitary cocycle trivial everywhere locally is trivial.

groups.label: Adeles of number fields
groups.gloss: Basic theory of adeles of a number field: topology, characters, Haar measure, and approximation by field elements.

groups.label: Automorphic forms on unitary groups
groups.gloss: Automorphic and algebraic modular forms on adelic unitary groups: cuspidality, rapid decay, inner products and Hecke eigenforms.

groups.label: Hecke operators and class sums
groups.gloss: Hecke operators on spaces of forms of a given level, and class sums written as integrals over arithmetic quotients.

groups.label: Quotient measures and unfolding
groups.gloss: Measures on quotients of groups by subgroups, and the unfolding method that turns integrals over quotients into sums.

groups.label: Adelic reduction theory
groups.gloss: Geometry of numbers for hermitian lattices over number fields, giving finite volume of the arithmetic quotient of unitary groups.

groups.label: Simple trace formula, unitary groups
groups.gloss: A simple trace formula for unitary groups, used to compare traces of Hecke operators on forms for different hermitian spaces.

groups.label: Adelic unitary groups
groups.gloss: Unitary groups of hermitian spaces over CM fields at adelic points, with levels, lattices and approximation results.

groups.label: Witt's theorem and Iwasawa decomposition
groups.gloss: Extending isometries of hermitian spaces, and decomposing unitary groups into compact, diagonal and unipotent parts.

groups.label: Dirichlet L-functions, quadratic twists
groups.gloss: Facts about Dirichlet L-functions: functional equation via theta series, Gauss sums, Landau's lemma, and a prime with zero-free quadratic twists.

groups.label: Prime number theorem in progressions
groups.gloss: Counts primes in arithmetic progressions, using growth of Dirichlet L-functions near the line Re s = 1 and a Tauberian theorem.

groups.label: Complex multiplication and Chowla–Selberg
groups.gloss: Elliptic curves with complex multiplication: their lattices, Galois conjugates, good reduction, and the Kronecker and Chowla–Selberg formulas.

groups.label: Formal groups of CM curves
groups.gloss: The formal group of an elliptic curve with complex multiplication: integral power series describing the group law near zero.

groups.label: Integrality of CM theta expansions
groups.gloss: Shows Taylor expansions of theta functions on CM elliptic curves have integral coefficients and integral values at torsion points.

groups.label: Weierstrass sigma and theta functions
groups.gloss: The classical sigma and Weierstrass functions of a lattice in the complex plane, and theta functions of CM elliptic curves.

groups.label: Grunwald's theorem
groups.gloss: Builds cyclic field extensions of prime degree with prescribed behaviour at finitely many primes.

groups.label: ℓ-adic avatars of Hecke characters
groups.gloss: Turns algebraic Hecke characters into ℓ-adic Galois characters and checks they match locally, including under base change.

groups.label: Continuous Galois cohomology
groups.gloss: Cohomology of Galois groups with discrete coefficients: cocycles, Shapiro's lemma, cup products, Kummer theory and index formulas.

groups.label: Global class field theory
groups.gloss: Global class field theory: the Artin map, reciprocity, norm theorems, the existence theorem and Chebotarev's density theorem.

groups.label: Greenberg–Wiles Selmer counting
groups.gloss: Counts the size of Selmer groups of Galois modules through relations at split primes, in the style of Greenberg and Wiles.

groups.label: Hecke characters of CM fields
groups.gloss: Hecke characters of CM fields and of the norm-one group U(1): existence with given weight, their values and ramification.

groups.label: Hecke L-functions
groups.gloss: L-functions of Hecke characters of number fields: Euler products, densities of primes, and analytic behaviour at s = 1.

groups.label: Local class field theory
groups.gloss: Local class field theory: the invariant of the Brauer group of a local field and the local Artin map.

groups.label: Local Tate duality
groups.gloss: Duality between Galois cohomology groups of a local field, including a version for crystalline cocycles.

groups.label: Places, decomposition and ideles
groups.gloss: Basic vocabulary of algebraic number theory: places, decomposition and inertia groups, Frobenius elements, local fields and ideles.

groups.label: Étale-type cohomology and Woods Hole
groups.gloss: Cohomology theories of varieties with torsion coefficients, base change, and a Woods Hole fixed point formula with an overview of the theory.

groups.label: Étale cohomology via functors
groups.gloss: Cohomology of varieties built as Ext groups of functors on rings, with comparison, continuity and excision results.

groups.label: Hodge cohomology and fixed points
groups.gloss: Hodge cohomology of smooth varieties with products, the class of the diagonal and a fixed point formula.

groups.label: Hodge–Tate classes of points
groups.gloss: Shows the Hodge–Tate map keeps classes of points on projective varieties nonzero and linearly independent.

groups.label: Projective line formula
groups.gloss: Computes the cohomology of the projective line and the Chern class of O(1) for several coefficient theories.

groups.label: Proper base change
groups.gloss: Proper base change for cohomology with ℤ/ℓ coefficients over absolutely integrally closed valuation rings.

groups.label: Stickelberger and odd class groups
groups.gloss: Cyclotomic field arithmetic: Stickelberger ideals, Gauss sums, and a uniform bound on the odd part of a Tate–Shafarevich-type group.

groups.label: Kolyvagin derivative classes
groups.gloss: Kolyvagin's method: build cohomology classes from Gauss sums and use reciprocity laws to bound class groups.

groups.label: Cusp kernels on unitary groups
groups.gloss: Shows certain convolution kernels on real unitary groups kill bounded functions invariant under a unipotent radical.

groups.label: Bessel models of U(p,q)
groups.gloss: Bessel functions on real unitary groups, the Haar measures of their unipotent subgroups, and L² bounds.

groups.label: Bruhat decomposition and floor measures
groups.gloss: Decompositions of split unitary groups into cells and floors, with the measures on them at real and complex places.

groups.label: Discrete series characters
groups.gloss: Characters, K-type multiplicities and formal degrees of discrete series of real unitary groups via orbital integrals.

groups.label: Flensted-Jensen discrete series construction
groups.gloss: Constructs discrete series matrix coefficients of U(p,q) as integrals and proves they are square-integrable Casimir eigenfunctions.

groups.label: Haar measure on unitary groups
groups.gloss: Explicit Haar measures on unitary groups via the Cayley chart and coordinates from Gram matrices.

groups.label: Holomorphic discrete series
groups.gloss: Holomorphic discrete series of unitary groups, their model functions, and where bounded holomorphic forms reach their maximum.

groups.label: Rigidity of highest weight vectors
groups.gloss: Shows vectors of a given highest K-type in a unitary representation of U(p,q) are pinned down by Casimir bounds.

groups.label: Local theta correspondence
groups.gloss: The local theta correspondence for real unitary dual pairs, via harmonic polynomials in the Fock model.

groups.label: Duality of GL(n) representations
groups.gloss: Duals of integral polynomial representations of GL(n), mixed weights and the Cartan product.

groups.label: Branching from GL(n+1) to GL(n)
groups.gloss: Restricting representations of GL(n+1) to GL(n) × GL(1): explicit branching maps that keep integrality, with norm bounds.

groups.label: Schur and Weyl modules
groups.gloss: Polynomial representations of GL(n) as Schur and Weyl modules: bases of minors, Gram matrices and norm bounds.

groups.label: Taylor–Wiles places, weight congruences
groups.gloss: Auxiliary Taylor–Wiles places, ℓ-adic models of forms with congruences changing the weight, and polynomials killing Frobenius.

groups.label: Cyclic base change, unitary groups
groups.gloss: Transferring eigenforms on definite unitary groups along cyclic extensions of prime degree using a twisted trace identity.

groups.label: Hilbert 90 for matrix groups
groups.gloss: Versions of Hilbert's Theorem 90 for general linear and unitary groups over finite, Artinian and profinite rings.

groups.label: Local-global compatibility at split places
groups.gloss: Checks that Galois representations attached to forms match the local behaviour of the forms at split places.

groups.label: Galois representations of unitary eigenforms
groups.gloss: Attaches ℓ-adic Galois representations to Hecke eigenforms on definite unitary groups of every rank.

groups.label: Pseudorepresentations and traces
groups.gloss: Semisimple representations are determined by their traces; pseudorepresentations and limits of traces.

groups.label: General combinatorics and topology
groups.gloss: Small general lemmas: the q-binomial theorem, Schur polynomials, open subgroups and images of ℓ-adic characters.

groups.label: Commutative algebra toolkit
groups.gloss: General commutative algebra: completions, Fitting ideals, lengths, long exact sequences, power series and perfect rings.

groups.label: Fourier analysis and integral estimates
groups.gloss: Real and complex analysis lemmas: Fourier transforms, Gaussian integrals, parameter integrals and Sobolev-type bounds.

groups.label: Schemes via functors of points
groups.gloss: Schemes described by their points over rings: line bundles, projective embeddings, étale charts and Galois covers.

groups.label: Matrix groups and finite characters
groups.gloss: Integral and congruence matrix groups, block triangular subgroups, and characters of finite and profinite groups.

groups.label: Matrix analysis and integral matrices
groups.gloss: Linear algebra lemmas: determinants and minors, hermitian matrices, eigenvalues, integral matrices and norm estimates.

groups.label: Haar measure and integration
groups.gloss: Measure theory lemmas: Haar measure normalisation, pushforwards, integral operators and measures on hermitian quadrics.

groups.label: Number fields and CM fields
groups.gloss: Number field basics: CM fields, differents, imaginary quadratic fields, units and class numbers, and ℓ-adic coefficient rings.

groups.label: Spherical Hecke polynomial roots
groups.gloss: Chains of roots of the Hecke polynomial of a spherical vector for GL(n) over a local field.

groups.label: Green's characters of GL_n(F_q)
groups.gloss: Characters of general linear groups over finite fields, after Green, built with the Hall algebra of class functions.

groups.label: Iwahori Hecke operators for GL_n
groups.gloss: Hecke operators at Iwahori and pro-p Iwahori level for GL(n) over a local field, and their eigenvalue exponents.

groups.label: Shintani descent over finite fields
groups.gloss: Shintani descent: relates characters of GL(n) over a finite field and over its extensions of prime degree.

groups.label: Crystalline comparison and Frobenius
groups.gloss: Shows p-adic cohomology of proper schemes is crystalline, with completion and tilting tools for the comparison.

groups.label: Crystalline comparison theorem
groups.gloss: The crystalline comparison theorem, built from divided power envelopes and checked on étale charts.

groups.label: Almost v-descent and tilting
groups.gloss: Descent for p-adic test rings: tilting, Fontaine's map and almost v-descent for perfect algebras.

groups.label: Alexander duality for compared cohomology
groups.gloss: Integration over the projective line and duality results such as excision and Alexander duality for compared cohomology theories.

groups.label: Hodge–Tate map and weights
groups.gloss: Constructs the Hodge–Tate map on p-adic cohomology and reads off Hodge–Tate weights of the Galois action.

groups.label: Primitive comparison theorem
groups.gloss: The primitive comparison theorem for p-adic cohomology with period coefficients, giving finiteness of p-adic cohomology.

groups.label: Tate–Sen theory and Bloch–Kato
groups.gloss: Core p-adic Hodge theory facts: Tate's vanishing theorem, Bloch–Kato crystalline classes, and p-adic Hecke characters.

groups.label: Crystalline representations
groups.gloss: Crystalline and potentially crystalline Galois representations, admissibility, and Hodge–Tate weights under operations on representations.

groups.label: Kisin modules
groups.gloss: Kisin modules over power-series charts in A_inf, period matrices of crystalline lattices, and the frame theorem.

groups.label: Limits of crystalline representations
groups.gloss: Shows limits of crystalline representations with bounded Hodge–Tate weights keep their local conditions.

groups.label: Fontaine's period rings
groups.gloss: Fontaine's period rings A_inf, the crystalline rings and B_dR, the map θ, and Ax's theorem on Galois invariants in ℂ_p.

groups.label: Hecke eigenquotients and theta structures
groups.gloss: Galois representations cut out of cohomology by Hecke eigenvalues, and theta structures on abelian schemes.

groups.label: Abelian schemes and isogenies
groups.gloss: Abelian schemes over a base: base change, isogenies, pairings of line bundles and coordinates near the identity.

groups.label: Theta functions on complex tori
groups.gloss: Theta functions on complex tori: Appell–Humbert data, factors of automorphy and the dimension of spaces of theta functions.

groups.label: Eichler–Shimura congruence relation
groups.gloss: The congruence relation at split places: Hecke operators on the reduction of a Shimura variety match Frobenius.

groups.label: Deformations and tangent spaces
groups.gloss: Bounds the tangent space of a moduli scheme of abelian varieties using first-order deformations over dual numbers.

groups.label: Good reduction of theta tori
groups.gloss: Shows certain complex tori defined by theta functions have good reduction, by bounding theta values at torsion points.

groups.label: Hecke operators on Kuga–Sato towers
groups.gloss: Hecke operators at split places acting on a tower of Kuga–Sato varieties, with levels and torsion counts.

groups.label: Integral models of Shimura varieties
groups.gloss: Builds integral models of moduli spaces of abelian varieties with PEL structure, as a tower of Kuga–Sato covers.

groups.label: Theta-coordinate moduli of abelian schemes
groups.gloss: Moduli of polarised abelian schemes embedded in projective space by theta functions, and existence of a universal family.

groups.label: Riemann theta relation and reduction
groups.gloss: Integral theta functions of abelian varieties, Riemann's theta relation and their behaviour under reduction at a valuation.

groups.label: Definite trace formula comparison
groups.gloss: A trace formula for algebraic forms on definite unitary groups, compared with orbit sums from the Shimura variety side.

groups.label: Lefschetz transfer of Hecke eigensystems
groups.gloss: Uses a Lefschetz fixed point count to show which Hecke eigensystems appear in the cohomology of a Shimura variety.

groups.label: Complex uniformisation of abelian varieties
groups.gloss: Complex abelian varieties as tori, period maps from adelic frames, and the complex ball model of the moduli points.

groups.label: Hermitian lattice masses and neighbours
groups.gloss: Masses of definite hermitian lattices, neighbouring lattices, and a reproducing formula for Fock vectors by theta lifts.

groups.label: Siegel–Weil formula
groups.gloss: The Siegel–Weil formula for split hermitian spaces in Weil's convergent range, relating theta integrals to Eisenstein series.

groups.label: Siegel's formula and local densities
groups.gloss: Siegel's formula for numbers of representations by hermitian lattices, through local densities at finite places.

groups.label: Rallis inner product formula
groups.gloss: The Rallis inner product formula by the doubling method: norms of theta lifts as L-values, and injectivity of the lift.

groups.label: Fourier coefficients and singular forms
groups.gloss: Fourier coefficients of automorphic forms along a unipotent radical, and singular forms controlled by few coefficients.

groups.label: Theta tower and constant terms
groups.gloss: Constant terms of theta integrals in a tower of unitary groups, Tate integrals, and the functional equation of character L-functions.

groups.label: Vacuum coefficients and Rallis series
groups.gloss: Coefficients of the spherical vacuum vector under neighbour steps, and a series of translates weighted by them.

groups.label: Theta lifts and the seesaw
groups.gloss: Theta lifts of forms between spaces, tame local Gauss sums, and the seesaw identity for periods.

groups.label: Definite unitary theta lifts
groups.gloss: Theta lifts between unitary groups of definite hermitian spaces, given by jets of theta functions acting on algebraic forms.

groups.label: Adelic Weil representation
groups.gloss: Construction of the adelic Weil representation from the Heisenberg group, with its theta functional and Fourier inversion.

groups.label: Unitary dual pairs, theta kernels
groups.gloss: Dual pairs of unitary groups: the Weil action of the pair, theta kernels, their decay and convergence of theta lifts.

groups.label: Fock model of Weil representation
groups.gloss: The Fock model of the Weil representation at a real place: polynomial vectors, inner products and matrix coefficients.

groups.label: Mixed Schrödinger models
groups.gloss: Mixed models of the Weil representation along isotropic splittings, used to compute constant terms of theta functions.

groups.label: Bessel periods of theta integrals
groups.gloss: Unfolding theta integrals over Bessel subgroups, constant terms of Weil functions and vanishing of theta descents.

groups.label: Unramified Hecke operators, theta lifts
groups.gloss: Hecke operators at unramified places for GL(n) and unitary groups, and how Hecke polynomials pass through theta lifts.

groups.label: From non-vanishing to RH
groups.gloss: Final step: no zeros with real part above one half implies all nontrivial zeros lie on the critical line.

groups.label: Periods of discrete series coefficients
groups.gloss: Lower bounds for periods of discrete series matrix coefficients over subgroups, by Laplace's method when weights are far apart.

groups.label: Regular families of twists exist
groups.gloss: States that suitable families of character twists exist, as the conclusion of the Selmer group argument in this folder.

groups.label: Ribet's method to first order
groups.gloss: Bounds congruence numbers by building Galois cohomology classes from congruent Galois representations, in the style of Ribet.

groups.label: Conjugate self-dual Galois representations
groups.gloss: Galois representations attached to the forms in the argument, and the hypotheses they satisfy for the Selmer bounds.

groups.label: Lifting crystalline extension classes
groups.gloss: p-adic Hodge theory estimates for extension classes of crystalline representations in large weight, using Kisin modules.

groups.label: Crystalline local conditions above ℓ
groups.gloss: Measures how much is lost at places above ℓ when Galois cohomology classes are required to be crystalline.

groups.label: Selmer groups of anticyclotomic twists
groups.gloss: Shows many anticyclotomic character twists have small Selmer groups, using Stickelberger systems and reciprocity at conjugate primes.

groups.label: Divisibility of theta jets
groups.gloss: Shows high derivatives of theta functions are divisible by many primes, with exponents matching a weighted prime count.

groups.label: The CM field K(ζ)
groups.gloss: The specific CM field E = K(ζ) used in the proof: how primes split, its different, and characters of given weight.

groups.label: Formal group and theta products
groups.gloss: Uses the formal group of a CM elliptic curve to control the p-adic shape of theta function products at non-split primes.

groups.label: Sharpness of valuation bound
groups.gloss: Shows the divisibility bound for derivatives of theta functions is attained, prime by prime.

groups.label: Integral vacuum of Weil representation
groups.gloss: An integral normalisation of the vacuum vector of the Weil representation, with bounds on its theta values and their jets.

groups.label: Auxiliary forms via grid paths
groups.gloss: Constructs auxiliary forms by moving periods of theta lifts step by step along paths through two grids of spaces.

groups.label: Norms of theta lift chains
groups.gloss: Computes the determinant of a chain of theta lifts as a product of determinants of single lifts.

groups.label: Exchange identity for theta integrals
groups.gloss: An identity relating theta integrals over unitary groups of complementary rank, up to constants given by L-values.

groups.label: Norms of theta lifts
groups.gloss: The theta lift from a definite space, its adjoint and its norm, with values in a weight representation.

groups.label: Theorem C: long integral forms
groups.gloss: Ratios of twisted to untwisted Hecke L-values, and the lower bound saying integral forms have large norm.

groups.label: Cost of one theta lift
groups.gloss: Height bound for the ratio of determinants of one theta lift with and without a twist.

groups.label: Comparison operator and gluing
groups.gloss: Builds an operator from three exchanges of theta integrals and shows products of theta kernels span the good forms.

groups.label: Periods of false lifts vanish
groups.gloss: Shows that forms orthogonal to theta lifts have vanishing periods, through a tower of vanishing theta descents.

groups.label: Hecke L-values as theta norms
groups.gloss: Writes Hecke L-values as squared norms of theta lifts of characters, and bounds their algebraic parts and heights.

groups.label: Main inequality and one-sided bound
groups.gloss: Combines Theorems A, B and C into the main inequality and derives a one-sided bound on prime sums.

groups.label: Admissible data and parameters
groups.gloss: Fixes the parameters of the proof: the CM field, its places, ranks, weights, level and twists, and bounds their sizes.

groups.label: Heights and twisted lattices
groups.gloss: Heights of families of numbers over all places, colengths of modules, and lattices with one map per twist.

groups.label: Prime sums and L-function zeros
groups.gloss: Relates weighted prime sums to zeros of L-functions: a one-sided bound on the error excludes zeros from a half-plane.

groups.label: Bessel functions at real places
groups.gloss: Bessel functions on real unitary groups: normalisation, decay, cutoffs and L² bounds needed for the second moment.

groups.label: Local orbital integrals over frames
groups.gloss: Local estimates at one place for integrals over pairs of frames, which bound densities in the second moment.

groups.label: Main term: sieve, Kloosterman sums
groups.gloss: Bounds the main term of the second moment with Poisson summation, Kloosterman sums and a sieve over places.

groups.label: Equal multiplicities of Hecke eigensystems
groups.gloss: Each Hecke eigensystem occurs with the same multiplicity on two unitary groups that differ only in signs at real places.

groups.label: Remaining terms via lattice counts
groups.gloss: Bounds the off-diagonal terms of the second moment by counting lattices and frames of small discriminant.

groups.label: Second moment and spanning theorem
groups.gloss: Shows translates of Poincaré series span the target forms, from a second-moment estimate.

groups.label: Unfolding Poincaré series
groups.gloss: Unfolds inner products of Poincaré series into sums of terms and proves the second-moment bounds from them.

groups.label: Divisibility of the composite lift
groups.gloss: Shows the composite theta lift is divisible by large powers of each prime, place by place.

groups.label: Elementary divisors of Hecke operators
groups.gloss: Bounds the elementary divisors of a Hecke operator on lattice functions, showing few forms are only weakly divisible.

groups.label: Theta kernel jets and bounds
groups.gloss: Galois conjugates, integrality and archimedean size bounds for jets of theta kernels between definite spaces.

groups.label: Source forms, target forms, chains
groups.gloss: Defines the main objects of the upper bound: spaces of forms, chains of theta lifts and the Poincaré map.

groups.label: Seesaw identity for lift chains
groups.gloss: An iterated seesaw identity writes a chain of theta lifts of Poincaré series as a combination of simpler lifts.

groups.label: Size of the composite lift
groups.gloss: Bounds the archimedean size of the composite lift and shows short forms span the ramified source forms.
